gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of Grade 4 glioma as defined by the 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System, including but not limited to glioblastoma, Grade 4 astrocytoma, and diffuse hemispheric glioma.

candidate_evidence.quote: to evaluate the safety, tolerability, and anti-tumor activity of TH-CART-027 cell injection in subjects with recurrent or progressive grade 4 glioma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subjects must have experienced relapse or progression following standard therapy and are unsuitable for or refuse further surgical resection.

role_evidence.quote: TH-CART-027 Cell Injection in Subjects With Recurrent or Progressive Grade 4 Glioma
Prior treatment with any CAR-T therapy or other gene therapy.

agents.drug_class_hint: CAR-T cell therapy (TH-CART-027), presumably B7-H3-directed given B7-H3 entry requirement; intratumoral/intraventricular infusion

source_quote.quote: B7-H3 Expression: ≥30% positivity for B7-H3 molecule in primary/relapsed tumor tissue by pathological testing.

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 CAR-T cell therapy (TH-CART-027 cell injection) in WHO 2021 grade 4 glioma including glioblastoma, IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma and diffuse hemispheric glioma. Cell therapy is an excluded intervention type, so no candidate. B7-H3 entry requirement is likely the CAR target but the record does not state the target; not candidate-matched because the CAR-T is not a candidate. NTRK/BRAF mention describes prior targeted therapy, not an entry biomarker. active_moiety is a generic descriptive name; the record calls it TH-CART-027.
